scope: Exact existing dated section rows retained unchanged; original-source review enriches presentation, not measurements.

records.name: Azores Current
records.range_interpretation: Source reports a rounded section span without a width uncertainty interval; not seasonal or annual variability.
records.geographic_scope: 24.5 W meridional section, 33.5-34.5 N, ORCA stations 39-55 study. Not a uniform along-route width.
records.section_orientation: Meridional section; not reinterpreted as exact flow-normal span.
records.layer: Eastward thermocline/intermediate flow reaching neutral density 27.975 kg/m3 (about 2000 m); not 110 km at every depth.
records.time_convention: 26 October-1 November 2009 station occupation within ORCA cruise 15 October-11 November 2009; single survey, not autumn climatology.
records.boundary_rule: Source-delimited current domain between 33.5 and 34.5 N based on hydrography and velocity/transport analysis. No universal velocity threshold assumed.
records.source_citation: Comas-Rodriguez et al. (2011), The Azores Current System from a meridional section at 24.5 W, Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans, doi:10.1029/2011JC007129.
records.source_locator: Abstract [1], Data and Methods [6], current domains [12] and Discussion [15].
records.extraction_method: Reported 110 km span transcribed; section limits recorded from prose. No source figure digitized or inferred axis width calculated.
remaining_gates: Review section boundary, vertical support and figure-caption date discrepancy.
Obtain repeated seasonal sections before annual variability or representative width.
Canonical measurement admission and release review.
records.source_quality_note: Figure 1 caption says fall 2010, whereas abstract/data text specifies 2009 and detailed station occupation 26 Oct-1 Nov 2009. Follow explicit data text and retain discrepancy pending review.
